summary: Three failures found by checking the market-intelligence stand-in screen at 320px against the better-layout reflow rule. Category names on a chart's x axis ran together ("PostersTypographyWayfinding…"): the axis now spaces its labels by the widest name plus 8px, guessed from the character count so the server agrees and corrected by measurement after paint, and a name thinned away is still in the tooltip, the announcement and the table view. A horizontal bar chart's fixed 168px name lane left the bars 8px: the lane is now capped at 40% of the row, which only binds below a 420px row, and a truncated name carries its full text as a title. And Table's scroll clip was not a containing block, so visually hidden text in a cell (the screen's "Not ranked") was placed against the page and scrolled it 33px sideways; the clip is now relative. Table's knownGaps also records that a fixed table whose declared lanes exceed its frame gives the flexing column 0px — the screen now sets minWidth.
